extracted.name: Quick and Easy Taco Soup
extracted.description: This super quick and easy taco soup is made with canned beans and corn combined with ground beef, tomato juice, and taco seasoning.
ingredient_lines: 1 (15 ounce) can kidney beans, drained and rinsed
1 (15 ounce) can black beans, rinsed and drained
instruction_lines: Heat a large stockpot over medium-high heat. Cook and stir ground beef in the hot pot until browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes. Drain and discard grease.
Add tomato-vegetable juice, tomatoes, corn, kidney beans, black beans, and taco seasoning to beef in the pot. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium and cook until heated through.
